description: Edge case: raw fee computes to exactly min_fee_uregen (1000000 uregen). Value 1000000000 × 0.001 = 1000000. Pins the opposite side of the boundary from the one-below vector — at equality, min_fee_applied is FALSE because the predicate is strict (rawFee < minFee, not <=). A future refactor that changes < to <= would flip this vector.
